object.name: evi_audiodust
object.description: Audio dust is a sparse random noise source driven at a given frequency. It produces 'spikes' at random amplitude and time offsets. It can be very useful as both a control signal and an audio signal. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' for more where this came from.

inlets.name: frequency
inlets.digest: The frequency at which to internally sample the noise. Typically used at low frequencies.

outlets.name: "white
outlets.digest: Synchronised to the audio dust process.

outlets.name: click
outlets.digest: Synchronised to the audio dust process for synchronising other processes downstream.
